notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where changing settings during gameplay caused scanned objects to become "Unknown Object".
[*] Fixed the FPS slider not updating its label text.
[*] Fixed a bug where the small scan pattern wouldn't update after using the detail Scan.
[*] Increased map zoom level.
[*] [spoiler]Reduced the frequency of Detail Scan messages.[/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] A unstuck button has been added to the pause menu, it returns you to the starting point.
[*] Fixed a bug where the sliders in the settings menu in the pause screen were applied only when pressing the Escape key.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Many objects now have a convex collider, which should significantly reduce issues with getting stuck.
[*] Added SFX Volume slider.
[*] Scan radius adjustment on the controller is now much smoother.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Two new options have been added to the Gameplay tab in the settings, allowing you to disable map markers and the object frame when scanning.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse was inverted when using detailed scanning with mouse inversion enabled.
[/list]

notes.title: "Relaxing" horror game LiDAR Exploration Program is PowerWash Simulator but with lasers
notes.notes:
LiDAR or "light detection and ranging" is a way of working out and picturing the distance to an object by shooting laser beams at it, and timing how long it takes the laser to bounce back to the scanner. It's been used for a bunch of Hard Science-y purposes, from mapping cave systems to measuring changes in the Amazon forest canopy. It's also become popular among artists, who use it to create high-fidelity yet abstractly coloured and ethereal visualisations of, for example, rivers. Now here's LiDAR Exploration Program, a "relaxing atmospheric horror" game from KenForest, in which you roam maps with a handheld LiDAR gun scanning the geography into being.
